thread.title: Silicon Valley stock index slides as tech giants fall

author: Marlize van Romburgh
title: Silicon Valley stock index slides as tech giants fall
text: – Assistant Managing Editor for Digital, Silicon Valley Business Journal Jan 30, 2018, 2:08pm PST The Bloomberg Silicon Valley High Technology index dipped 0.9 on Tuesday as shares in some of the biggest U.S. technology companies sank. The index was dragged down by Applied Materials (NASDAQ: AMAT), Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD), Intel Corp. (NASDAQ: INTC), Oracle Corp. (NASDAQ: ORCL), Symantec Corp. (NASDAQ: SYMC), HP Inc. (NYSE: HPQ) and Cisco Systems (NASDAQ: CSCO), among others. In fact, the index of 13 of the Valley's biggest tech stocks saw only one rise: Facebook (NASDAQ: FB), which closed up slightly at 0.61 percent. The Menlo Park-based company said today that it's banning advertising of cryptocurrencies on its platform, for now at least, as part of its crackdown on misinformation and foreign interference. The Silicon Valley index's biggest member, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) dipped 0.59 percent. The Cupertino company, which reports earnings on Thursday, has been hit by a raft of reports predicting slowing iPhone sales over the last few weeks. The company is also delaying some iPhone software updates to concentrate on quality control issues, Bloomberg reported Tuesday . Separately, the U.S. Justice Department is probing Apple over potential securities law violations related to its disclosure of the software that deliberately slowed older iPhone models to save battery power, Bloomberg reported . The company has since apologized to consumers and offered to replace batteries on those phones at a discount. Other Silicon Valley stocks that fell on Tuesday: Sanmina Corp. (NASDAQ: SANM) fell 6.03 percent after the company reported a first-quarter loss . The company earlier this month said it's closing three plants and warned that its first- and second-quarter earnings would come in below analyst expectations. Shares of Applied Materials sank 3.52 percent. Roku ’s stock (NASDAQ: ROKU) dipped 1.98 percent. Silicon Valley stocks that posted the biggest gains on Tuesday: GoPro (NASDAQ: GPRO) rose 2.82 percent. Lumentum Holdings (NASDAQ: LITE) climbed 1.35 percent. Equinix (NASDAQ: EQIX) bounced 1.01 percent. Ranked by East Bay employees Rank
